description:
Replaces the whole profile with the body. **No credit cost.** Send at least one of
`description` or `website`. A `description` longer than 1500 characters is truncated to
1500 characters, the same cap the `/profile` bot command applies, so both surfaces store the
same record. A `website` is a URL or a bare domain; the site is crawled into the shared
knowledge base in the background, and `derived_offering` fills in later
(`derivation_status` is `pending` until then). The offering is kept while the website is
unchanged and cleared when the website changes.

inputSchema.description: The profile to store. Both fields are optional, but at least one must be non-blank. A description longer than 1500 characters is truncated, not refused.

website.description: The seller's website, a URL or a bare domain. Blank clears it.
